videos.title: The Small Edge That Helps Water Climb #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Two liquid columns rise before the close view, with the thinner column ending higher.
editorial.mechanism: The same reservoir and columns remain visible through enlargement; rim length versus cross-sectional area explains the inverse-radius equilibrium. A third-radius case resolves near the end.
editorial.readability: Comparison circles were reduced to clear both reservoir and captions. The narrow-column height label was moved outside its walls; the wider label fits between its walls. Final area values were shortened to 1 and 4 inside their circles.
editorial.pacing: The opening rise and final altered column are events, while the central explanation deliberately holds its reference level. Pause samples were independently checked.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused checks recovered two omitted opening words and did not repeat an apparent gear-word duplication in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The tubes are schematic vertical lines with exaggerated widths and no modeled meniscus or transient rise law. The circular area comparison is a separate view, and much of the middle is static. No audience recognition or aesthetic preference was measured.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: A Bowl of Light and Its Return Journey #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Parallel rays now visibly gather in the opening, before the detailed reflection explanation.
editorial.mechanism: A persistent parabolic cross section moves closer. The local normal and reflection follow the actual surface continuously as the meeting point moves; reversed paths resolve the final claim.
editorial.readability: The focus label was moved off the ray bundle and arrowheads reduced to keep the focal point visible. Dense transition samples supplement the broader interval.
editorial.pacing: The opening demonstration replaced a long wait for the first ray. The final ray directions are resolved, then the scene holds for the closing sentence.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused checks recovered two omitted opening words and did not repeat an apparent gear-word duplication in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The bowl remains a clean cross-sectional diagram, with no material environment or depth. The local normal is named but equal-angle arcs are not drawn. Sampled images do not establish felt pacing, prosody or learning.

videos.title: The Narrow Opening That Lets Light Spread #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A soft light band supplies a concrete pattern, although the opening initially shows a static state rather than the width change.
editorial.mechanism: First-minimum markers follow the analytic sinc-squared pattern as the slit narrows and widens. The screen coordinate is explicitly sine angle.
editorial.readability: A changed-view redraw preserves the transformed band height and slit endpoints. Peak normalization and compressed brightness are disclosed; mathematical labels stay separate from captions. The light pattern sits on a dark screen so minima visibly correspond to darkness rather than unpainted cream paper.
editorial.pacing: The key narrowing has dense intermediate samples; the final reopening visibly restores a narrower central band. Focused transcription recovered a word omitted by full-file ASR.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused checks recovered two omitted opening words and did not repeat an apparent gear-word duplication in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The relationship between the separate slit and far-field screen is diagrammatic, without propagated wavefronts. Brightness is a display encoding, and the first cancellation is explained rather than derived from paired wave contributions. No perceptual brightness or viewer understanding was tested.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Quiet Rhythm of Moving Inward #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Two colored weights turn on a visible platform, retaining their identities in a larger top view.
editorial.mechanism: An analytic integral drives angular phase while both radii change. Nonzero platform inertia and the work of inward actuation are included in the explanation.
editorial.readability: The radius label was moved clear of the radial line. The platform remains in view to explain why the total speed increase differs from the isolated point-weight scaling.
editorial.pacing: Rotation continues through the final narration and outward movement rather than stopping at each cue. A focused transcription recovered the opening verb missed in full-file ASR.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused checks recovered two omitted opening words and did not repeat an apparent gear-word duplication in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The drawing omits the physical mechanism that pulls the weights inward and shows no hands or material texture. A substantial early section is a held diagram. No subjective listening, enjoyment or learning was measured.

videos.title: Two Circles Sharing a Mechanical Rhythm #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Two meshing gear outlines turn immediately, with visibly different angular speeds.
editorial.mechanism: The enlarged pair keeps the same tooth counts and locations. Complete rotations show one-small to half-large, then one-large to two-small, with opposite direction.
editorial.readability: Tooth-count labels sit below their gears. Dense samples cover the first full rotation; the teeth are explicitly schematic and the rotation ratio conditional on correct engagement.
editorial.pacing: The final gear motion continues during the closing sentence. Focused ASR did not repeat an apparent extra word in the full-file transcript.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused checks recovered two omitted opening words and did not repeat an apparent gear-word duplication in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: No individual teeth are numbered, and the driver-role exchange has no motor or hand to show its cause. Tooth undercut, fillets and contact forces are not modeled. The algebraic statement uses speed magnitudes; opposite directions are explained separately. No viewer response was measured.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.
